title: Do I have coverage for weight loss surgery?

author: DrCurry
bodyHtml: There are many patients out there who would benefit from weight loss surgery, but they don’t know if their insurance will cover it. It can be hard to figure this out sometimes, but JourneyLite is here to help! Watch this brief, informative video and find out the questions you need to ask. If you find out that you do have coverage, just fill out the form below to make an appointment with our team!
